localizedValues.name: GI-PH03
localizedValues.description: This campground is located on the islands of Mingan Archipelago National Park Reserve and is only accessible by boat. Dry toilets and a supply of fire wood are located nearby. Campers must walk 250 m to reach the campground after landing. There is no potable water on the islands. Bring an adequate supply of food and potable water for two additional days (two litres per person per day). Bring warm and waterproof clothing as well as a small axe and matches or a lighter. A good communication system is strongly recommended. Reservations for passage to the islands with local boat operators is required. For info: 418-538-3285.

localizedValues.name: GI-PH03
localizedValues.description: Cet emplacement de camping se situe sur les îles de la réserve de parc national de l'Archipel-de-Mingan et n'est accessible que par bateau. À proximité se trouvent des toilettes sèches et une réserve de bois de chauffage. Une marche de 250 m doit être effectuée pour se rendre aux emplacements de camping à partir de la zone de débarquement. Il n’y a pas d’eau potable sur les îles. Apporter suffisamment de nourriture et d'eau potable pour 2 jours supplémentaires (2 litres/personne/jour) Apporter des vêtements chauds et imperméables ainsi qu'une hachette et des allume-feu. Un système de communication adéquat est fortement recommandé. Réservation requise auprès des transporteurs maritimes reconnus par Parcs Canada. Pour info : 418-538-3285.

À proximité se trouvent des toilettes sèches et une réserve de bois de chauffage. Une marche de 1,2 km doit être effectuée pour se rendre aux emplacements de camping à partir du débarcadère. Le sentier de niveau facile se trouve en bordure du littoral et en milieu fragile où le passage est étroit par endroit. Il n’y a pas de charriot pour le transport des bagages sur cette île. Il n’y a pas d’eau potable sur les îles. Apporter suffisamment de nourriture et d'eau potable pour 2 jours supplémentaires (2 litres/personne/jour) Apporter des vêtements chauds et imperméables ainsi qu'une hachette et des allume-feu. Un système de communication adéquat est fortement recommandé. Réservation requise auprès des transporteurs maritimes reconnus par Parcs Canada. Pour info : 418-538-3285.

localizedValues.name: Nue02
localizedValues.description: This campground is located on the islands of the Mingan Archipelago National Park Reserve and is only accessible by boat. Dry toilets and a supply of fire wood are located nearby. Campers must walk 1.2 km to reach the campground after landing from the wharf. The path, of easy level, is situated along the shore line, in a fragile environment, and is narrow at some point. There is no cart available to carry luggage on this island. There is no potable water on the islands. Bring an adequate supply of food and potable water for two additional days (two litres per person per day). Bring warm and waterproof clothing as well as a small axe and matches or a lighter. A good communication system is strongly recommended. Reservation for passage to the islands with local boat operators is required. For info: 418-538-3285.

localizedValues.name: Havre-HS01
localizedValues.description:
This camping location is on the islands of Mingan Archipelago National Park Reserve and is accessible only by boat. Nearby, there are dry toilets and a firewood supply.
A walk of a few hundred metres or more (depending on the landing site) is required to reach the campsites. This distance must be covered both ways along the shoreline (intermediate level on uneven terrain).
A cart is available for transporting luggage (ask our staff).
There is no drinking water on the islands.
Bring enough food and drinking water for an additional 2 days (2 litres/person/day).
Bring warm and waterproof clothing, as well as a hatchet and fire starters.
An adequate communication system is strongly recommended.
For information: 418-538-3285

For information: 418-538-3285

localizedValues.description:
This campground is located on the islands of Mingan Archipelago National Park Reserve and is only accessible by boat. Dry toilets and a supply of fire wood are located nearby. Campers must walk 400m to reach the campground from the wharf. A cart is available to help move your gear.
The oTENTik tent is a spacious blend of a tent and an A-frame cabin equipped with beds and furniture on a raised floor.
Included with each oTENTik:  Interior: one table, four chairs and a bench; one double bed and four single beds with mattresses; storage unit; a broom and dustpan, dishpans and kettle; fire extinguisher, smoke detector and carbon monoxide detector; charging station for small electronic devices (USB port). Exterior: Propane barbecue with brush (propane included), storage unit, four camping chairs, fireplace and a picnic table.
What to bring: Sleeping bags, blankets and pillows, flashlight(s) and cooking equipment. Bring an adequate supply of food and potable water for two additional days (two litres per person per day). Bring warm and waterproof clothing as well as a small axe and matches (or a lighter). A good communications system is strongly recommended.
Reservations for passage to the islands with local boat operators is required. For info: 418-538-3285.
* Important: the configuration of the bay of Île Quarry and the higher number of visitors during the high season could disturb the peace and quiet of the site.
